page_note: No cosmological substrate on this page. The page is a complete narrative-pedagogical unit: catechumen complaint about Elect (frame), the Illuminator's rebuke, and a parable of the fragrant tree applied explicitly to the Elect (i=33). The tree parable uses natural-correspondential imagery (fragrance, smoke, axe, fire) but every mapping resolves to the institutional category of 'the elect' — cosmos→ecclesia, not cosmos→cosmos. Editorial fatigue score is misleadingly negative because cosmological_substrate vocabulary appears in the second half (parable register), but the parable is deployed for institutional defense, not systematic teaching. Heavy damage (64.7%) hampers some judgments but the structural shape is clear.
